name: URL Content Ingestion Workflow
description: Fetch any URL (webpage, PDF, docs), extract key facts, create intel file, ingest to memory, and verify. Enables RAG queries against the content.

steps.description: Fetch URL content (handles webpages, PDFs, docs)

steps.llm_prompt:
Create an intel file for Jarvis's knowledge base from this URL content.

Source URL: ${article.url}
Page Title: ${article.title}
Stash Reference: ${stash_ref}
Extracted Keywords: ${keywords}
User Notes: ${user_notes}

Full Content:
${article.content}

---

Generate an intel file in this EXACT format for optimal ingestion:

# ${article.title}
Source: ${article.url}
Stash: ${stash_ref}
Ingested: ${timestamp}

## Overview
[2-3 sentence summary of what this documentation/page covers]

## Key Concepts
- [Concept 1]: [Brief explanation]
- [Concept 2]: [Brief explanation]
- [Continue for all major concepts, definitions, features]

## Important Facts
- [Fact 1 as key: value or descriptive bullet]
- [Fact 2]
- [Continue for all notable facts, limits, specifications]

## Usage/Examples
- [If applicable, key usage patterns or examples]

## Related Topics
- [Keywords and related concepts for search]

IMPORTANT FORMATTING RULES:
1. Use `Key: Value` format where possible (enables structured extraction)
2. Use bullet points with `-` for lists
3. Be comprehensive - extract ALL important facts, concepts, limits, specifications
4. Keep values concise but complete
5. Do NOT wrap in markdown code blocks - return raw content only
steps.description: Create intel file with structured facts

success_speech: URL ingested. I fetched ${url_domain} and created an intel file. Facts are being added to memory in the background - you can ask questions about it shortly.
abort_speech: Failed to ingest URL. The page may be inaccessible or have content restrictions.
